generation_method.train: Template generation: 12 hand-written scenario families per category x 5 framing/location variants (all variants of a family stay in train). Plus deduplicated NYC descriptor text if downloaded.
generation_method.validation: 24 hand-written sentences, 6/category, scenario families not used in train.
generation_method.test: 20 hand-written in-scope sentences (5/category) + 4 policy cases, separate families; untouched until train.py --evaluate-test.
generation_method.demo: 90 simulated Tel Aviv map reports (seed 42): 12 roads near 32.068,34.774; 10 waste near 32.080,34.782; 8 lighting near 32.103,34.792 (jitter <=60 m); 60 scattered. Illustrative points, not verified incident locations. Never used for training/evaluation.

caveats: Synthetic evaluations share generation bias with training data and do not establish real-city accuracy.
Raw NYC records stay NYC records; no NYC coordinates are moved to Tel Aviv.
Classifier input is text only (no complaint_type, agency, category code or city metadata).
